problem.statement_latex: Given a finite ring $R$, an ideal $I$ generated additively by $k$ elements, and oracle access to a multilinear polynomial map $f:R^m\to R$, decide whether $f$ vanishes on $I^m$. Complexity counts ring and evaluation queries.
problem.statement_text: Given a finite ring $R$, an ideal $I$ generated additively by $k$ elements, and oracle access to a multilinear polynomial map $f:R^m\to R$, decide whether $f$ vanishes on $I^m$. Complexity counts ring and evaluation queries.

quantum.headline_latex: $O(m(1+\alpha)^{m/2}k^{m/(m+1)})$ queries by Arvind--Mukhopadhyay when $k\ge(1+1/\alpha)^{m+1}$. The quantum walk searches tuples of generating-set combinations.
quantum.headline_text: $O(m(1+\alpha)^{m/2}k^{m/(m+1)})$ queries by Arvind–Mukhopadhyay when $k\ge(1+1/\alpha)^{m+1}$. The quantum walk searches tuples of generating-set combinations.

classical.headline_latex: $O(4^m m k)$ randomized queries via ring identity testing; direct testing of generator tuples uses $O(k^m)$ evaluations. For fixed $m$, the former is linear in $k$.
